# Frely docs

> User documentation for Frely: accounts, billing, models, FrelyMCP, the Frely CLI, and creating on Frely.

## Pages

- [Let AI help run your servers without handing over your SSH keys](https://github.com/FrelyHQ/docs/blob/main/en/blog/ai-server-ops-without-ssh-keys.md): Giving an AI assistant ssh access from your laptop exposes every key in ~/.ssh. Connecting the server itself to your AI account keeps keys off the table and every permission revocable.
- [What a sandbox runtime does when AI runs commands on your computer](https://github.com/FrelyHQ/docs/blob/main/en/blog/sandbox-runtime-protect-your-data-from-ai-commands.md): A plain explanation of Anthropic's open-source sandbox runtime (srt): how it limits files and network at the OS level, where it stops, and how Frely CLI uses it to keep your credentials away from the commands an AI runs.
- [Account and sign-in](https://github.com/FrelyHQ/docs/blob/main/en/faq/account.md): Answers about a Frely account: how to create it, how to sign in, how to keep it safe, and how to close it.
- [Billing, Credit and refunds](https://github.com/FrelyHQ/docs/blob/main/en/faq/billing.md): Answers about Frely billing: topping up Credit, Creator plans, renewal, cancellation and refunds.
- [Creating and selling on Frely](https://github.com/FrelyHQ/docs/blob/main/en/faq/creating.md): Answers for creators on Frely: what you can publish and sell, what buyers receive, and how the privacy of your work is handled.
- [Devices and the Frely CLI](https://github.com/FrelyHQ/docs/blob/main/en/faq/devices.md): Answers about devices and the Frely CLI: installing the CLI, linking a computer to your account, keeping it working, and removing it.
- [Privacy and your data](https://github.com/FrelyHQ/docs/blob/main/en/faq/privacy-data.md): Answers about privacy on Frely: what data Frely stores, for how long, and how to control analytics.
- [Using models and API keys](https://github.com/FrelyHQ/docs/blob/main/en/faq/using-models.md): Answers about using models on Frely: API keys, client settings, usage, and what to do when a request fails.
- [Use Frely in ChatGPT](https://github.com/FrelyHQ/docs/blob/main/en/guides/chatgpt.md): Add Frely to ChatGPT as a connector, then call your Frely models from a chat.
- [Use Frely in Claude](https://github.com/FrelyHQ/docs/blob/main/en/guides/claude.md): Add Frely to Claude as a custom connector, or to Claude Code as an MCP server.
- [Use Frely with Skill and CLI](https://github.com/FrelyHQ/docs/blob/main/en/guides/cli.md): Install the Frely CLI and its Skill so your AI agent can use your Frely account and control your own computers from a terminal.
- [FrelyMCP (alternative)](https://github.com/FrelyHQ/docs/blob/main/en/guides/frelymcp.md): Use FrelyMCP when your AI app cannot run commands: it gives Claude, ChatGPT and other MCP clients access to your computers, cloud tools, models and agents.
